title: Whistler Premium Journey Private Tour from Vancouver
includes: Scenic stops along the Sea-to-Sky Highway
Hotel, Airbnb, cruise terminal or downtown Vancouver pickup and drop-off
AI-powered audio guide experience during the journey
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape Vancouver for a full-day private journey along the world-famous Sea-to-Sky Highway to Whistler. Travel in a premium all-electric Volkswagen ID. Buzz while enjoying an AI-powered audio guide experience that brings the region’s history, culture, and natural landmarks to life.

This private tour includes scenic stops at Lions Gate Bridge, the North Shore waterfront, Horseshoe Bay, Shannon Falls, and Squamish before arriving in Whistler Village. Enjoy breathtaking mountain and ocean views, explore one of Canada’s most famous resort destinations, and discover the beauty of British Columbia at your own pace.

With private transportation, flexible timing, hotel or cruise terminal pickup, and small-group comfort for up to 5 guests, this experience offers a relaxed and personalized alternative to large bus tours.
